name: Wind Chimes
summary: A porch wind chime with six tuned tubes that swing in 3D, glow and play real notes in the breeze
about: A wooden chime hangs from a porch beam over a garden at dusk, with six metal tubes, a striker puck and a carved leaf sail all swinging as real pendulums in three dimensions. Wave your pointer to make wind, send a gust or tap a tube: every hit plays a struck-metal note with a soft echo, flashes down the tube and sends a coloured note bubble up, and all six together make a full chord. Good for a meditation or sleep app page, a garden shop or a calm sound toy.
how: Move your pointer across the scene to blow on the chime; faster moves make stronger wind.
Press Gust: the leaves rustle, there is a short lull, then a push of wind sets the striker swinging.
Tap any tube to ring it, or focus the scene and press 1 to 6; ring all six within a couple of seconds for a full chord.
Choose Dusk, Bright or Night to retune the tubes and change their metal, and set the Breeze slider.
Sound starts after your first tap and can be switched off; reduced motion stops the drifting leaves.
